method: Same scripted conversation twice. 'off' uses explicit prompt caching with no breakpoints, so nothing is cached. 'on' uses implicit caching. Tokens and costs are read back from model_calls. The counterfactual prices the 'on' arm's own calls as if every input token were uncached, which removes the difference in call count between arms.
